Message.Name: Options Quote Message
Message.Description: Two-sided message providing best bid and offer limits of orders on complex symbols with aggregated volumes at each limit.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The series sequence number.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The Ask price. A positive value is implicit (no sign), a negative value is indicated by a negative sign. Use the Price scale from the Series Index message.

Field.Name: Ask Volume
Field.Description: Total quantity available at the above Ask price

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The Bid price. A positive value is implicit (no sign), a negative value is indicated by a negative sign. Use the Price scale from the Series Index message.

Field.Name: Bid Volume
Field.Description: Total quantity available at the above Bid price.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote condition.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: AskCustomerVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity of customer orders at the Ask price

Field.Name: BidCustomerVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity of customer orders at the Bid price

Message.Name: Options Trade Message
Message.Description: Used to publish the complex Last Sales.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The series sequence number.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Trade price. A positive value is implicit (no sign), a negative value is indicated by a negative sign. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The volume of the trade in contracts.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Reserved 3
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Series RFQ Message
Message.Description: Pass-through message from the matching engine published for both Outright and Complex series in the event of a COA auction or a CUBE auction on complex orders.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the RFQ.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Order Type of CUBE/COA/BOLD

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Customer or Firm capacity specified with the order. Only used for BOLD (Type = B).

Field.Name: Total quantity
Field.Description: Total quantity

Field.Name: Working Price
Field.Description: RFQ Price for CUBE/COA

Field.Name: Participant
Field.Description: OCC number for the Clearing firm specified with the order. 0 if no OCC number was specified. Only used for BOLD (Type = B).

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Auction ID for CUBE/COA

Field.Name: RFQ Status
Field.Description: Status field for CUBE/COA (Type = C).
